thread:
Maya Chen: Hi team — did a quick pass on Aerolyft telemetry, noticing P95 latency creeping up during long-doc summarization (tokens > 512) and a small uptick in tail error rate. proposing a low-risk optimization path: int8 quant swap + regional routing canary to reduce cost and steady the tail.
Devin Arora: Nice, do you have numbers?
Maya Chen: From last 72h: avg latency 230ms, P95 680ms for long requests, error spike ~0.8% (mostly timeouts). cost per 1k tokens up ~14% vs baseline. canary idea: route 5% of long-doc traffic to rw-open-3b-q8 in us-west, keep rest on rw-open-7b.
Samir Patel: any eval impact expected? need to know delta on quality before we touch prod.
Devin Arora: Quick check on our eval set shows ~0.6% BLEU drop on ultra-long prompts with q8 on this model family. for typical summaries it's ~0.1–0.2%. acceptable tradeoff if latency wins.
Maya Chen: proposed rollout plan (canary -> ramp):
```yaml
routing_policy:
  name: aerolyft-long-docs-optimization
  match:
    - header: content-length-tokens
      op: ">"
      value: 512
  routes:
    - model: rw-open-3b-q8
      region: us-west-2
      weight: 0.05
      canary: true
    - model: rw-open-7b
      region: us-east-1
      weight: 0.95
rollout:
  monitor: telemetry/aerolyft/long-docs
  metrics:
    - latency.p95
    - errors.rate
  auto-roll-back: true
  ramp: [5, 20, 50]
```
Maya Chen: Also suggest enabling prefix KV caching for repeated document store IDs — that will cut token counts for re-runs. I can prod the enablement playbook and schedule a 30-min session with Aerolyft CS + devs.
Devin Arora: one more thing: recommend measuring QA by sampling canary responses and running our eval harness nightly for the canary cohort. will add a small eval job against their prompt set.
Samir Patel: capacity note: us-west pool currently has spare slots but it's a shared Dedicated pool. if Aerolyft uses reserved throughput, we should confirm there's headroom for the extra q8 instances. pinging @eng-runtime to confirm.
eng-runtime-bot: Deploy plan drafted: https://console.redwood/deploys/plan/4319876543 - canary window 2h, alerting hooks configured.
Maya Chen: thanks — can someone from eng confirm infra? if all good i'll open the rollout and book the enablement call for Thu 10:30 PT.
Devin Arora: LGTM from ML side, I'll own evals and monitor quality delta.
Samir Patel: SRE OK pending confirmation of q8 pool from infra. I'll follow up with ops ticket.
ops-deploy: Canary created: deploy-4319876543-canary (5%). logs -> https://logs.redwood/aerolyft/4319876543
Maya Chen: great, added action items: 1) ops confirm pool headroom, 2) devs approve routing config, 3) ML will run nightly evals, 4) schedule enablement + customer sync. tagging @Aerolyft-eng in thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Devin Arora: small note — if quality drop >1% on the sampled set at any ramp step, we abort and fallback to rw-open-7b automatically. configured in rollout.
Samir Patel: will update ticket when infra green.
Maya Chen: thanks all — will post final rollout link and customer invite once infra clears.
